scope: Local CPU handoff claim graph validation; no model KV/QA/TTFT claims
authorization: User continuous Agent improvement and direct main publication after verification; no other repositories
supervision: Manual host execution; no managed DAG, tmux monitor, ReviewSession or service claimed
hypothesis: claim_graph repeated pending scans are quadratic for deep chains; a valid-graph linear topological pass can reduce complete entry-point latency
proposal: Use reverse edges and unresolved-parent counts for valid graphs. Preserve original loop as fallback on unknown parents, supported-to-unsupported edges or detected cycle, retaining existing multi-error precedence. Avoid changing schema checks, returned graph, claim objects or model behavior. Evaluate fallback duplication cost before acceptance.
prior_search: /tmp/agent-claim-prior-search.json; 223 scanned, partial=true, 65 errors; six lexical hits not accepted for new performance claim

dag.done_when: intent, guide, assumptions, prior results, acceptance, risk, resources reviewed; no blockers
baseline snapshot, algorithm/candidate, permanent regressions and paired raw observations frozen
actual code and raw data review, independent graph reference and paired measurement; usable-with-scope
full unittest/Reader and relevant -O pass; final source unchanged
owned files/archive/checkpoint reviewed, fresh fetch and atomic nonforce main update, remote SHA/tree/content readback

performance.primary: median complete call latency reduction >=25% in 512 chain
performance.controls: each small/empty median regression <=15%; preserve negative results; inconclusive=no publish
performance.inputs: public synthetic, canonical hash and fixed seed; object output identity/serialization parity

correctness: empty, singleton, deep chain beyond recursion depth, broad DAG and duplicate dependencies
cycle/self-cycle, disconnected cycle, unknown parents, unsupported edges, malformed fields and multi-error differential parity
no mutation, full returned graph and object identity; plain and subclass container controls where feasible
independent generated graph/reference checks; run focused tests then full suite

resources.stop: validation failure, insufficient reliable performance gain or interface change required

publication_constraints: No PR/branch, force push, guide edits, large logs or private data. Record scoped Chinese report and parent Progress. No new public result without independent acceptance.
